name: Chocolate Chip Pecan Blondies
description: Chewy, buttery blondies with toasted pecans and chocolate chips, baked in a 9x12 pan.

steps.title: Prep pan and toast nuts
steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line a 9x12x2 pan with parchment, leaving an overhang on two sides. Spread the pecans on a sheet pan and toast while the oven heats.

steps.title: Mix the wet ingredients
steps.text: Whisk the melted butter and brown sugar until smooth. Whisk in the eggs and vanilla.

steps.title: Fold in dry ingredients
steps.text: Add the flour, baking powder and salt and fold until just combined. Fold in the chocolate chips and the toasted pecans.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread the batter evenly in the pan. Bake until the edges are set and golden and the center is just barely firm. A toothpick should come out with moist crumbs, not wet batter.

steps.title: Cool completely
steps.text: Cool in the pan, then lift out by the parchment and cut into squares. Cutting too early makes them gummy.

notes: Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Add 2 to 3 minutes if your oven runs cool or the pan is full to the top.
If you only have white sugar, use 1 1/2 cups white sugar plus 1 to 2 tablespoons molasses, honey or maple syrup for chew and caramel flavor. Without it they come out lighter and slightly crisper.
Walnuts work in place of pecans. They're a bit more bitter, which is nice against the chocolate.
Keeps 3 to 4 days covered at room temperature, and freezes well wrapped in individual squares.
